title: Critical poison and bleeding healing can return with pretend full mana

impact.description: Retained source report; practical reachability, actual outcome and port applicability require independent review.

notes: Lead supplied by borg-rs, not independently reproduced by Mandos. A function-context link is not proof of the reported defect. Related sub-symptoms remain grouped pending triage. Related pretend-mana state mechanism: CBUG-0015 (escape); this report concerns distinct heal branches.

reported_sources.text:
`borg_heal()`: the two critical blocks (poisoned, bleeding) set
  `BI_CURSP = BI_MAXSP` and put the real value back only after their spells
  fail. When a spell is cast, or (bleeding block, where the fake mana is set
  before the potions) a cure or restore-mana potion is quaffed first, the
  function returns with `BI_CURSP` still at `BI_MAXSP` until the traits are
  next recomputed (as C bug 35).

next_at_import: Check current C and both ports, duplicate-search the exact symptom, then reproduce a legal scenario with controls before a local proposal. No C submission.
